methodology.name: annual_budget_per_mile
methodology.source: ASSUMPTION. Check only: BWSC water program $99.3M over 3 years (docs/budget_agent_reference.md) over 1,018 miles is about $32.5k per mile per year for water alone; BWSC schedules a minimum of 8 miles of pipe a year (bwsc.org water system page, read 2026-10-31). No source for the road share
methodology.note: Capital budget per mile of street per year (pipe and road together).

methodology.name: breaks_per_mile_year
methodology.source: 35 failures a year / 1,018 miles of pipe. Failures: BWSC CIP, 'just over 35 per year', as quoted in docs/budget_agent_reference.md (original not re-read). Miles: https://www.bwsc.org/environment-education/water-sewer-and-stormwater/water-system, 'approximately 1,018 linear miles of pipe', read 2026-10-31
methodology.note: Breaks per mile per year (N_target = this x miles). Caveats: BWSC's 35 is an average over past years; BWSC miles of pipe are not our simulated street miles (839 city-owned miles), assumed here to be one mile of main per street mile.

methodology.name: proposal_fraction
methodology.note: Share of segments each agent may propose on.

methodology.name: central_proposal_fraction
methodology.note: Share of segments the central planner scans.

methodology.name: reserve_max_fraction
methodology.note: Cap on the simulated reserve as a share of the budget.

methodology.name: reserve_fraction
methodology.note: Fixed reserve; used only when reserve_mode is fixed.

methodology.name: urgency_full_prob
methodology.note: Yearly failure probability that scores urgency 1.0.

methodology.name: critical_facility_multiplier
methodology.note: Urgency boost for a critical facility.

methodology.name: urgent_cap_fraction
methodology.note: Tier 1 work may use at most this share of the spendable amount.

methodology.name: urgent_override
methodology.note: Urgency at or above this is Tier 1 and can be funded below the hurdle.

methodology.name: min_return
methodology.note: Return hurdle per dollar.

methodology.name: dig_fixed
methodology.note: Cost to open one street segment, paid once per opening (evidence_plan.md priority 1).

methodology.note: Pipe work cost per foot.

methodology.note: Repaving cost per foot.
